title: Covista Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Results; Raises Fiscal Year 2026 Revenue and Adjusted Earnings Per Share Guidance
summary: Total enrollment up 6.8% YoY, with Chamberlain returning to positive total enrollment growth Surpassed 100,000 students including record enrollment at Chamberlain and Walden Revenue up 4.5% YoY; revenue up 8.4% YoY when adjusted for Walden one-week academic shift Third quarter highlights Total student enrollment 100,585, up 6.8% year-over-year, achieved 11 th straight quarter of growth Revenue $487.0 million, up 4.5% year-over-year; up 8.4% year-over-year when adjusted for Walden one-week academic shift Chamberlain University returned to positive total enrollment growth, delivered the highest enrollment in university history, and achieved 15 th straight quarter of pre-licensure BSN total enrollment growth Walden University achieved 11 th straight quarter of total enrollment growth, up 12.3% year-over-year, highest total enrollment in university history GAAP net income $41.6 million; adjusted EBITDA $127.9 million Capital allocation Repurchased $66 million of shares in the third
